market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: The US acquiring part of Greenland is extremely unlikely. Denmark and Greenland have repeatedly rejected any such overtures, and no binding agreement or legal mechanism is being pursued. Even a hypothetical change in US administration would face massive legal and diplomatic hurdles, making a resolution by end of 2026 improbable.
evidence_points: Trump's 2019 purchase offer was publicly dismissed by Denmark and Greenland, and no subsequent serious negotiations have occurred.
Greenland's self-government and Danish constitutional protections require local and Danish consent, which is not forthcoming.
There is no active US legislation or executive action aimed at acquiring sovereignty or exclusive jurisdiction over any part of Greenland.
sources_consulted: Historical news on Trump's Greenland purchase proposal and rejections
Current US foreign policy priorities under the Biden administration
